newsitem.title: USA: Newfield plans $173 mln in 1997 spending.
newsitem.headline: Newfield plans $173 mln in 1997 spending.

text.p: Newfield Exploration Co said Thursday its current capital spending plans for the full year 1997 total $173 million, with at least 25 additional exploratory and development wells planned.
In addition, the company said it is also planning two major platform installations.

On Thursday the company reported first quarter earnings of $11.9 million, or $0.32 per share, on revenues of $46.9 million, up from year-ago earnings of $7.9 million, or $0.22 per share, on revenues of $33 million.
